Arabian mandi, served the way it’s meant to be shared

Smoky rice, juicy mutton and broasted chicken, brought out on low tables where you sit on carpets and eat together. Three years in, Ladhidh Mandi is still a favourite for families, friends and couples in Attapur.

The menu

Prices are approximate Zomato delivery prices. Dine-in prices may differ.

Single-person portions are available. Complimentary soup is served with mandi.

Sit low. Stay long.

Teal velvet majlis seating, hand-woven jute wall art, rope screens and floating wooden discs. Floor seating and table-and-chair seating are both available, and there are private rooms for couples and families.

Low tables on patterned carpets, the traditional way.
